meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

copy.tagline: 添加新渠道,调整自动触发,接入更多服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 NanoClaw 并想扩展它的消息渠道或触发方式
copy.tagline_en: Add new messaging channels and adjust how your assistant responds
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to add channels or change triggers.

howto.what: 装上后，当你想给 NanoClaw 添加新渠道、新集成或改任何行为时，Claude 会先提问弄清你的需求，然后按流程装好插件、改好配置，最后告诉你怎么验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 添加新渠道（如 Telegram、Slack 等）、改触发规则、加集成，或做任何其他定制时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 加进来当输入渠道。
给我加一个 Google 日历的 MCP 工具，只读就行。
修改一下触发词，让 Slack 里的消息也能唤醒这个 agent。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you want to add new channels, integrations, or change NanoClaw behavior, Claude first asks clarifying questions, then follows the workflow to install adapters or update configs, and finally tells you how to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add new channels (Telegram, Slack, etc.), change trigger rules, add integrations, or make any other customizations to NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel.
say_en.note: Claude asks which agent group and isolation level first.

say_en.text: Add a read-only Google Calendar MCP tool.
say_en.note: It asks for the target agent group, then runs /add-gcal-tool or manual setup.

say_en.text: Change trigger rules so Slack messages can also wake this agent.
